usageNotes: Use this endpoint to inspect the node-level vzdump backup defaults before triggering or scheduling a backup job — it reveals the effective compression, mode, retention, and storage settings that will apply if not explicitly overridden. Optionally pass a storage ID to see storage-specific defaults (some fields like notes-template and protected are only returned when a storage is provided). A caller needs at least Datastore.Audit or Datastore.AllocateSpace on the target storage; Sys.Audit on the node is required to see node-scoped settings like the hook script path.

examples.summary: Retrieve vzdump defaults for node pve1 scoped to local-zfs storage

tips: If no storage is passed, the response reflects global node defaults; storage-specific fields (notes-template, protected) will be absent.
The mailto and mailnotification fields are deprecated — prefer notification-mode set to 'notification-system' with configured PVE notification targets.
Default compress is '0' (none) and default mode is 'snapshot'; confirm these match your backup policy before scheduling jobs.
prune-backups defaults to 'keep-all=1', meaning backups are never pruned unless explicitly overridden — check this if storage space is a concern.
